description: Privacy-focused real-time network monitor and application firewall with per-process traffic attribution, local traffic history, and opt-in IP threat intelligence.
notes: Live packet capture requires Npcap, which is not bundled; install it separately from https://npcap.com/. Packet capture also requires Snitch to run with administrator privileges. Snitch stores its database and settings in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Snitch; Scoop does not remove that data. The built-in updater remains enabled and can replace Scoop-managed files independently of Scoop; it can be disabled in Snitch Settings or with SNITCH_NO_UPDATE=1 if you prefer Scoop-controlled updates.
